name: Asian Paints Ltd
read: Margin and volume guidance has been broadly credible; CapEx commitments lack follow-through disclosure, and H2 FY27 targets currently trail.

events.label: Q4 volume growth band maintained
events.quote: Q4 volume growth 12.4% exceeded the 7.5-10.9% band; band maintained and beaten.

events.label: margin contraction limited to ~100 bps
events.to: H1 FY26 PBDIT margin 18.5% (Q2), up 230bps YoY
events.quote: Margins expanded, not contracted, in H1 FY26; contraction limit easily held.

events.label: Maintain 18-20% PBDIT margin guidance
events.quote: FY26 closed at 18.8% PBDIT margin, inside the 18-20% band promised.

events.label: volume-value gap 4-5%
events.to: FY26 volume ~9%, value growth lower; gap ~4-5% (Q1: 3.9% vol vs -1.2% val; Q2: 10.9% vs 6%; Q3: 7.9% vs 2.8%; Q4: 12.4% vs 10.2%)
events.quote: Volume-value gap stayed roughly 4-5% through FY26; delivered as guided.

promises.label: Maintain 18-20% PBDIT margin guidance
promises.evidence: Q4 FY26 call, pNone; reported financials FY26
promises.verdict: FY26 closed at 18.8% PBDIT margin, inside the 18-20% band promised.

history.quote: as of now, we will keep the guidance on in terms of our 18 to 20% guidance
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: volume-value gap 4-5%
promises.actual: FY26 volume ~9%, value growth lower; gap ~4-5% (Q1: 3.9% vol vs -1.2% val; Q2: 10.9% vs 6%; Q3: 7.9% vs 2.8%; Q4: 12.4% vs 10.2%)
promises.evidence: Q4 FY26 call, p11; quarterly calls FY26
promises.verdict: Volume-value gap stayed roughly 4-5% through FY26; delivered as guided.

history.quote: the gap has come down in the decorative range as I said, and that is what we are looking at in maintaining as we go ahead
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

history.quote: volumes would be higher... the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: Q4 volume growth band maintained
promises.verdict: Q4 volume growth 12.4% exceeded the 7.5-10.9% band; band maintained and beaten.

history.quote: given the fact that the second quarter for us was at about 10.9%, this quarter is about a high-single-digit. I think as we go ahead, this band would remain
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: margin contraction limited to ~100 bps
promises.actual: H1 FY26 PBDIT margin 18.5% (Q2), up 230bps YoY
promises.verdict: Margins expanded, not contracted, in H1 FY26; contraction limit easily held.

history.quote: you are saying the contraction would not be more than about a 100 bps
history.speaker: Amit Syngle (responding)

promises.label: PBDIT margin guidance 18-20%
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 consolidated PBDIT 20.6%; Q2 FY27 standalone 17.1%, H1 consolidated 18.2%
promises.evidence: Q1 FY27 call, p17; Q2 FY27 call, p22-23
promises.verdict: H1 FY27 consolidated margin 18.2% sits at band's floor; on track but thin cushion.

history.quote: We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

history.quote: we are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: FY27 volume growth band 8-10%
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 volume 9%; Q2 FY27 6.4%; H1 ~8%
promises.evidence: Q1 FY27 call, p10; Q2 FY27 call, p14
promises.verdict: H1 volume ~8% within 8-10% band, though Q2's 6.4% dipped below; on track overall.

history.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

history.quote: we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: Maintain 18-20% EBITDA margin band for FY27
promises.verdict: H1 at 18.2%, within 18-20% band but at the lower edge; rest of year decisive.

history.quote: we believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: Expect 8-9% volume growth going forward
promises.verdict: Q2 volume 6.4% is below the 8-9% expectation; H2 must accelerate to deliver.

history.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward
history.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: ~₹700 crore CapEx this year
promises.verdict: ₹700cr FY26 CapEx never confirmed; later ₹3,250cr total CapEx cited, no FY26 breakdown.

history.quote: we have committed closer to 700 crores of CapEx this year
history.speaker: Amit Syngle
